_doc: Causality rules. When an action node becomes REPORTED (a witness finished their radio call, or the action was public) these effects fire. '$target' = the faction that owned/was the victim. 'moral' is how crew judge the act (mercy / order / greed, -2..+2), applied even if nobody reported it, because crew always find out.

theft.label: Theft
news: LUMEN FLASH: Petty thief strikes {location}. Shareholders 'mildly inconvenienced'.
BREAKING: {target_name} property relocated without a receipt at {location}. Experts call it 'theft'.
LUMEN CRIME: Item 'liberated' at {location}. {target_name} launches a sad little press release.
BREAKING: Shoplifter at {location} 'just really wanted it', say witnesses.
LOCAL: {target_name} reports theft at {location}. Insurance adjusters weep with joy.

vandalism.label: Vandalism
news: LUMEN FLASH: Advertising surface assaulted at {location}. The ad is reportedly 'still believing in you'.
BREAKING: Hooligan disrespects a billboard at {location}. Billboard declines to comment, as it is broken.
LUMEN ARTS: Unsanctioned redecoration at {location}. Critics: 'bold'.
LOCAL: Public property at {location} expresses itself, violently.
BREAKING: Vandal strikes {location}. Ad revenue down 0.0001%. Markets panic.

assault.label: Assault
news: LUMEN FLASH: Unprovoked violence at {location}! Victim's productivity down 40%.
LUMEN FLASH: Brawl at {location}. Both parties billed.
BREAKING: Assault at {location}. Paragon: 'we were on our break'.
LOCAL: Fists thrown at {location}. Witnesses rate it 3 stars.

murder.label: Murder
news: BREAKING: Homicide at {location}. {target_name} mourns the loss of a fully-depreciated asset.
LUMEN EXCLUSIVE: Killer at large near {location}! Paragon Compliance offers a bounty and a discount on grief counselling.
LUMEN SPECIAL REPORT: Tragedy at {location}. Sponsored by MediCredit(tm).
BREAKING: Body found at {location}. Halcyon confirms the debt will be passed to next of kin.
MOURNING AT {location}: Family asks for privacy, Lumen declines.

kill_hostile.label: Combat kill
news: LUMEN SPORTS: Armed altercation at {location}. Final score: one drifter, {target_name} nil.
LUMEN SPORTS: {target_name} employee 'retired early' at {location}.
LOCAL: Shootout at {location}. Both sides claim victory. One side is wrong.

bribe.label: Bribery
news: LUMEN BUSINESS: Informal transaction at {location}. Economists praise 'market efficiency'.
LUMEN BUSINESS: Money changes hands at {location}. As is tradition.
ECONOMY: Informal economy booming at {location}, say informal economists.

mercy.label: Mercy
news: LUMEN HUMAN INTEREST: Someone at {location} did something nice. Analysts are baffled.
LUMEN FEELINGS: Someone at {location} chose mercy. Ratings unclear.
LOCAL HERO? Mystery helper strikes again at {location}.

charity.label: Charity
news: LUMEN BUSINESS: Unlicensed generosity reported at {location}. Halcyon warns it could 'destabilise poverty'.
LUMEN HUMAN INTEREST: Stranger gives credits away at {location}. Experts baffled.
LOCAL: Act of kindness at {location} goes viral. Halcyon investigating.

trespass.label: Trespass
news: LUMEN FLASH: Unauthorised footsteps detected at {location}.
LOCAL: Footsteps detected where footsteps were not purchased at {location}.

intimidate.label: Intimidation
news: LOCAL: Citizen at {location} 'spoken to firmly'. Citizen now very quiet.

smuggle.label: Smuggling
news: LUMEN FLASH: Contraband detected near {location}. Paragon reminds citizens that freedom is a premium feature.
LUMEN CRIME: Contraband air seized near {location}. Seized air 'very refreshing', say officers.
BREAKING: Smugglers active at {location}. Paragon raises prices on vigilance.
